name: Power Coefficient from Tip-Speed Ratio (Parametric)
description: Power output is parametrically computed from tip-speed ratio λ through the Cp curve: P = 0.5×ρ×A×Cp(λ)×v³. Rotor speed uncertainty propagates through this affine approximation to power uncertainty.

elements.name: Rotor Angular Speed
elements.description: Rotor angular speed from pitch control closed loop.

uncertainty.source: IEA 15 MW OpenFAST simulation: rotor speed variation from pitch control tracking error at rated wind

elements.name: Minimum Rated Power
elements.description: Grid code: minimum power output raised to 14.5 MW after contract renegotiation [threshold adjusted to 0.76 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(ω) = F·ω + f; F = dP/dω = 0.5×ρ×A×(dCp/dλ)×(R/v)×v³ — parametric Cp-curve sensitivity
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: power output CZ is affine image of rotor speed CZ through Cp(λ) curve sensitivity.
